buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery

time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SPECIFICATION : PLATE HOOK DRG.NO.OFB/C/1560 FOR CARRIERS & ALL COMMON BOXES. Note : Sample should got approved before bulk supply alongwith material test certificate from NABL/Govt. lab. for conforming to physical & chemical properties of material to relevant specification given in relevant drawing. Pre-qualification criteria i. Firms which are established for the bid item or same range of products/goods i.e. any type of steel shee t components in any Govt. department. ii. If the firm is established for bid item or same range of products/goods i.e. any type of steel sheet compo nents in other than Ordnance Factory Bhusawal in that case firm has to submit supporting documents in t his regard (i.e. Supply Order copy, Tax Invoice/proof of successful supply/successfully execution of supply order, Drawing and & also submit registration certificate for bid item or same range of products/goods i.e. any type of steel sheet components are eligible to participate. Iii. Firm shall submit attached compliance statement of O. F. Bhusawal bid duly signed and stamped. iv Non-compliance of above terms and conditions may result in termination of participation and offer of the Firm will be liable for rejection. Bids without submission of above supporting documents will be summarily rejected and no further correspondence in this regard will be done. This may be strictly adhered to.. BIDDER UNDERTAKING I have read the clause mentioned in ATC in this bid and given compliance of the following clauses : 1) Specification 2) Drawing 3) Delivery Period 4) Option Clause 5) Inspection Clause 6) Bidder Financial Standing 7) Non-Involvement in Cartel Formation: We hereby give an undertaking that we will not be a part of cartel with other vendors and will be quoting competitive rates in the tenders invited by the YANTRA INDIA LIMIT ED, ORDNANCE FACTORY BHUSAWAL. 8) Material: Pre inspection report, Guarantee/warranty certificate and Test Certificate should be sent along with supply. The material will be checked by Govt. lab/NABL lab and the results of the lab will be the sole c riteria for acceptance of the item. 9) Loading/Unloading: Offer should be for Ordnance Factory Bhusawal. Unloading of Goods at OFBH premis es will be done by the supplier. 10) Product Delivery: a. Each package/bags shall be suitable marked with identification marking to enable satisfactory reference with the corresponding Invoice and GeM contract number. Marking on Each package/bags must contains r eference Invoice number. GeM contract number, Qty, Item description, Outer dimension, volume and gross weight in Units should as per contract. If identification marking on each package/bags is not available or n ot matching with reference Invoice Qty then firm is responsible delay to acceptance of material or for any short supply. Every Gunny/Plastic/Packaging bag containing the material/component should be sufficient s trength/strong enabling to bear standard way of handling and not to tear easily. b. Supplier must generate Physical Invoice Qty as per Lot wise Qty of stagger delivery period mention in re spective contract. GeM invoice to be generated at time of delivery as per physical invoice Qty within delive ry period. If supplier get any difficulties to generate the GeM Invoice within delivery period then contact to GeM help desk to resolve the issue. c. Each Consignment should be Supply with following documents in

1. Physical Tax Invoice (2) GeM Invoice copy (Qty should be matched with Tax Invoice Qty) (3) Test Report (NABL or as per GeM Contract T&C) (4) Guarantee/Warranty (5) Pre-Inspection Report d. In case of Supplier has failed to provide the above mentioned documents along with each Consignment then material will not be taken inside the Factory. 11) Guarantee/Warranty: The stores supplied against the order shall be deemed to have been warranted b y the contractor against deterioration/defective material and workmanship and performance for a period of 12 months from the date of receipt of stores at our end and any material found rejected/defective during t he Guarantee/Warranty period, the same should be replaced free of cost. 12) Payment Terms: Payment terms shall be 100% payment through NEFT/RTGS only for accepted materia l within 30 days for the date of receipt of material or submission of bills/documents whichever is later. 13) For any other rules and regulations pertaining to this bid will be applicable as per latest YIL Store Procu rement manual available of YIL site : yantraindia.co.in/en/e-library 14) Note: In case any query/information please contact to Provisioning section, Ordnance Factory Bhusawa l at ofbhpvmm@ord.gov.in or 02582-222552, 222907, Extn-241. . 5.
